beats.say: A message says your account is locked and you must tap this link right now.
Scammers love pressure, because a rushed person does not stop to think.
Before you tap, look at the web address. Small spelling tricks are a common sign of a fake.
Better still, do not use the link at all. Open the app or type the site yourself.
If it is really about your account, you will see it there too.
Slow down, check twice, and send this to someone who clicks too fast.

youtube.title: That link might be fake. Check this first 🎣
youtube.description:
Scam messages push you to hurry. Check the address, then open the app or type the site yourself instead of tapping the link.
